cohort: Neonates admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit of the Tamale Teaching Hospital from January 2019 to December 2019 with axillary temperature documented at the time of admission
finding: The prevalence of neonatal hypothermia was 54.76% and was higher in neonates requiring intervention at birth.
mod_finding: Neonates who were delivered vaginally were less likely to develop hypothermia compared to those delivered via Cesarean section.
birth_weight: Low birth weight neonates were more likely to be hypothermic
